skirmish.module.alerts.name: Alerts
skirmish.module.alerts.description: HolyWorld: what drops if you log out (shulkers, backpacks, Elements), a Disconnect confirmation and region intrusion alerts.
skirmish.module.alerts.setting.logout_wa: On HolyWorld, show a banner while logging out would drop items: 2+ shulker boxes or backpacks (shulker mode) or any Element (Prime).
skirmish.module.alerts.setting.confirm_d: While logging out would drop items, the Disconnect button first asks "Leave anyway / Stay". You decide.
skirmish.module.alerts.setting.confirm_i: Ask the same while the combat tracker sees an active fight (leaving in PvP mode usually costs the whole inventory).
skirmish.module.alerts.setting.region_al: Turn the "Осторожно! В один из ваших регионов вторгся …" message into an on-screen alert.
skirmish.module.alerts.setting.region_so: A bell on intrusion (on top of the server's sound). Switch off to keep only the alert.
skirmish.module.alerts.setting.region_hi: How many earlier intrusions to list under the latest one.
skirmish.alerts.region.title: Region intrusion
skirmish.alerts.confirm.title: Leave now?
skirmish.alerts.confirm.hint: Put shulkers and Elements into a chest, or wait for the fight to end.
